#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Heart Rate Variability analysis of a ~5-minute resting ECG recording.

Computes the standard HRV index set (time, frequency, nonlinear domains and the
combined all-domain table) from the ECG channel of the supplied recording,
following the methodology operationalized in NeuroKit2's HRV module
(Pham et al., 2021, doi:10.3390/s21123998):

1. R-peak detection on the raw (uncleaned) ECG with the gradient-based
   "neurokit" QRS detector (no artifact / ectopic correction).
2. RR intervals in ms as differences of consecutive R-peak samples / fs;
   non-finite intervals dropped; no detrending, interpolation or artifact
   correction for the time and nonlinear domains.
3. Time-domain, frequency-domain (quadratic interpolation to 100 Hz, Welch PSD
   with Hann window, normalized, standard band edges) and nonlinear-domain
   indices (Poincare, fragmentation, asymmetry, (MF)DFA, complexity entropies
   and fractal dimensions, symbolic dynamics).

Outputs: hrv_time.csv, hrv_frequency.csv, hrv_nonlinear.csv, hrv_indices.csv
(one header row + exactly one data row, columns prefixed HRV_, empty field =
"not defined for this recording").
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
import warnings

# Use a non-interactive backend before any plotting-related import happens
# inside the analysis library.
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


TIME_COLS = [
    "MeanNN", "SDNN", "SDANN1", "SDNNI1", "SDANN2", "SDNNI2", "SDANN5",
    "SDNNI5", "RMSSD", "SDSD", "CVNN", "CVSD", "MedianNN", "MadNN",
    "MCVNN", "IQRNN", "SDRMSSD", "Prc20NN", "Prc80NN", "pNN50", "pNN20",
    "MinNN", "MaxNN", "HTI", "TINN",
]
FREQ_COLS = [
    "ULF", "VLF", "LF", "HF", "VHF", "TP", "LFHF", "LFn", "HFn", "LnHF",
]
NONLINEAR_COLS = [
    "SD1", "SD2", "SD1SD2", "S", "CSI", "CVI", "CSI_Modified", "PIP",
    "IALS", "PSS", "PAS", "GI", "SI", "AI", "PI", "C1d", "C1a", "SD1d",
    "SD1a", "C2d", "C2a", "SD2d", "SD2a", "Cd", "Ca", "SDNNd", "SDNNa",
    "DFA_alpha1", "MFDFA_alpha1_Width", "MFDFA_alpha1_Peak",
    "MFDFA_alpha1_Mean", "MFDFA_alpha1_Max", "MFDFA_alpha1_Delta",
    "MFDFA_alpha1_Asymmetry", "MFDFA_alpha1_Fluctuation",
    "MFDFA_alpha1_Increment", "DFA_alpha2", "MFDFA_alpha2_Width",
    "MFDFA_alpha2_Peak", "MFDFA_alpha2_Mean", "MFDFA_alpha2_Max",
    "MFDFA_alpha2_Delta", "MFDFA_alpha2_Asymmetry",
    "MFDFA_alpha2_Fluctuation", "MFDFA_alpha2_Increment", "ApEn", "SampEn",
    "ShanEn", "FuzzyEn", "MSEn", "CMSEn", "RCMSEn", "CD", "HFD", "KFD",
    "LZC", "Symbolic_EqualProb4_0V", "Symbolic_EqualProb4_1V",
    "Symbolic_EqualProb4_2LV", "Symbolic_EqualProb4_2UV",
]

SAMPLING_RATE = 100  # Hz, uniform sampling of the supplied recording


def load_ecg(input_dir):
    path = os.path.join(input_dir, "bio_resting_5min_100hz.csv")
    data = pd.read_csv(path)
    ecg = np.asarray(data["ECG"].values, dtype=float)
    return ecg


def _domain_frame(df, names):
    """Return a single-row DataFrame with HRV_-prefixed columns in the
    requested order, restricted to the columns defined for that domain."""
    if df is None or len(df) == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("HRV domain computation returned no results.")
    row = df.iloc[0]
    out = {}
    for name in names:
        col = "HRV_" + name
        if col in row.index:
            val = row[col]
        else:
            val = np.nan
        out[col] = val
    return pd.DataFrame([out], columns=["HRV_" + n for n in names])


def _to_float_frame(df):
    """Coerce the domain DataFrame to plain float values."""
    result = df.copy()
    for c in result.columns:
        result[c] = pd.to_numeric(result[c], errors="coerce").astype(float)
    return result


def run_analysis(input_dir, output_dir):
    ecg = load_ecg(input_dir)

    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")

        import neurokit2 as nk

        # 1. R-peak detection on the raw, unfiltered ECG (gradient-based QRS
        #    detector, no artifact correction).
        _, info = nk.ecg_peaks(
            ecg,
            sampling_rate=SAMPLING_RATE,
            method="neurokit",
            correct_artifacts=False,
        )
        peaks = np.asarray(info["ECG_R_Peaks"], dtype=int)
        if len(peaks) < 2:
            raise RuntimeError("Fewer than two R-peaks detected; cannot compute HRV.")

        # 2-5. Domain computations on the RR interval series.
        out_time = nk.hrv_time(peaks, sampling_rate=SAMPLING_RATE)
        out_freq = nk.hrv_frequency(peaks, sampling_rate=SAMPLING_RATE)
        out_nonlinear = nk.hrv_nonlinear(peaks, sampling_rate=SAMPLING_RATE)

    time_df = _to_float_frame(_domain_frame(out_time, TIME_COLS))
    freq_df = _to_float_frame(_domain_frame(out_freq, FREQ_COLS))
    nonlinear_df = _to_float_frame(_domain_frame(out_nonlinear, NONLINEAR_COLS))
    indices_df = pd.concat([time_df, freq_df, nonlinear_df], axis=1)

    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    # Write with full round-trip precision; undefined values become empty fields.
    time_df.to_csv(os.path.join(output_dir, "hrv_time.csv"), index=False, na_rep="")
    freq_df.to_csv(os.path.join(output_dir, "hrv_frequency.csv"), index=False, na_rep="")
    nonlinear_df.to_csv(os.path.join(output_dir, "hrv_nonlinear.csv"), index=False, na_rep="")
    indices_df.to_csv(os.path.join(output_dir, "hrv_indices.csv"), index=False, na_rep="")

    return indices_df


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--input-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    run_analysis(args.input_dir, args.output_dir)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
rationale: Approach: I verified against the pinned NeuroKit2 0.2.13 source that every methodological clause in the public contract (R-peak detector with 0.1 s / 0.75 s boxcar smoothing, 1.5x threshold, 40% QRS-length cut, 0.3 s mindelay; RR series in ms with no detrending; ddof=1 statistics; 1000/128 ms histogram for HTI/TINN; pNNx over count+1; quadratic interpolation to 100 Hz with constant-end fill; Welch Hann density PSD with resolution-based nperseg capped at N/2, nfft=2*nperseg, max-normalization, [f_min, 0.5 Hz] restriction and half-open band integration with zero-power bands left empty; MSEn AUC=sum of finite scale entropies with scales 1..N/(dim+10); DFA windows 4-11 and 12..(N+1)/10; 4-level equal-probability symbolic words) corresponds exactly to the default call path nk.ecg_peaks(raw ECG, method="neurokit", correct_artifacts=False) followed by nk.hrv_time / hrv_frequency / hrv_nonlinear at sampling_rate=100. I additionally reproduced the frequency-domain powers, SD1, pNNx, HTI etc. from scratch (scipy interp1d quadratic + scipy.signal.welch + numpy statistics) and got bit-level agreement with the library outputs, confirming the pipeline implements the specified definitions rather than merely trusting the function names. The program therefore calls the three domain functions and assembles the four output tables with the exact column sets/ordering from the contract; the combined table is the exact concatenation of the three per-domain tables (verified identical values). Undefined values (SDANN2/SDNNI2, SDANN5/SDNNI5 because fewer than three complete 2- or 5-minute windows fit a 5-minute recording; ULF because its normalized power integrates to zero below the 0.0134 Hz resolution floor) are written as empty fields. Runtime is ~1 s on 4 CPUs, far within the 600 s budget; runs fully offline. Limitations: numerical output depends on the pinned library/scipy versions (I used the supplied ones); CSV values are written at repr-level float precision (~17 significant digits) so round-trip loss is negligible; agreement with the hidden reference has not been observed in this session, only conformance to the public methodology contract.
